G01 PASS grounding -- routes are V^tau in lexicographic order; N_2 by enumeration equals e_x^T (I+A_G)^2 1; state and orbit counts match section 4.1
G02 PASS executable rules -- destinations are states; STEP, REPLAN, WEATHER, FUEL follow sections 1.3 and 1.4
G03 PASS reciprocity -- every channel has a reverse in its class, bridge, and store; STEP/REPLAN 1:1, WEATHER 1:b_c, FUEL 1:b_h
G04 PASS accounting -- one packet per bridge change with its named store; hot outflow equals cold inflow; J = (b_c+1)<|G|>_p - K
G05 PASS undriven world -- undriven graph strongly connected; b_c^(-|G|) in detailed balance on every undriven channel
G06 PASS driven steady state -- driven graph strongly connected; every channel symmetric under relabelling; orbit solution positive; lifted law balances every state
G07 PASS GLOBAL calibration -- GLOBAL steady states are q^|G| with q = 2/(b_c + b_h); H_global and J_global equal their closed forms
G08 PASS second law and the floor -- J > 0; second law in store symbols; nonnegative pair terms; certified eta in (0,1); GLOBAL eta meets its closed form
G09 PASS warming rival -- s*(J) > 0 inverts J_warm with r_(s*) = rho wherever J < J_max; GLOBAL has rho = 2/(b_c+b_h+2), s* = 1, E = 1
G10 PASS Xypher slot reading -- slots bound; Ruby empty, Opal absent; rates read only [State, Bridge, Class, StoreRatio, PermissionSet] (RateInputs) and equal the section 1.3 rule
G11 PASS frozen values -- section 4.1 and 4.2 values reproduced exactly; Y_global and eta_global decimals match
